primaryComponent.description: Governed, accessible, searchable language selector component consuming the authoritative locale registry
designPrinciples: Searchable with instant live filtering across native names, English names, and locale tags
Clear visual distinction between currently applied language (emerald badge) and candidate pending selection (blue checkmark / ring)
Bounded scroll container (max-h 340px desktop, 380px mobile) with overflow scrolling
Dual ARIA semantics: radiogroup with radio buttons, or listbox with options
Full keyboard navigation: ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Space, Escape
Touch friendly with minimum 48px target height and touch-manipulation CSS
Strict production firewall enforcement: only PRODUCTION_READY locales selectable in production

propsInterface.currentLocale: string (optional, defaults to active context or en-PH)
